title: Qi Sources
text:
/cultivation qisource here <element> [size] [storage_fraction] [regen_ticks]

/cultivation qisource at <x> <y> <z> <element> [size] [storage_fraction] [regen_ticks]

Size is radius in blocks. Storage fraction scales capacity from 0 to 1. Regen ticks are the full refill duration; 20 ticks = 1 second. Omitted values are randomized. Tab suggests values; ~ coordinates are supported.
